_doc: Rules for the pane signals the watch does NOT derive in code. busy, fresh and stuckText stay in lib.mjs - they carry three measured incidents and that logic is not touched. Only the newer signals live here, as DATA, for one reason: the patterns for the permission dialog are second-hand and their positive half is unverified. A pattern nobody has seen live must cost one line to correct.

regions._doc: whole = the whole pane. bottom(N) = the last N lines WITHOUT the footer line (the one carrying the double arrow). The footer is excluded for the same reason as in paneBusy: a client release moved permanent text into it and made every upgraded session eternally busy.

rules._doc: Under the resume dialog the pane does not mirror the session's state, and the line looks like the input box's text. Verified string - resumeStep recognises the same screen.
The resume picker, same reason. Verified string from resumeStep.

UNVERIFIED POSITIVE HALF. The pattern comes from another implementation's rule file, not from a pane seen blocked here. The negative half IS measured: zero hits in six live panes. If you see a blocked session whose text does not match - correct this line, not the code.
